content.short: Relay is a cross-chain bridging and execution protocol built for low-cost instant transfers.
content.description: Relay is cross-chain payments infrastructure connecting more than 85 blockchains, with swaps and bridges completing in seconds. Phantom, MetaMask, OpenSea and over a hundred other integrations route through it, with more than 20 billion dollars settled on its own count. One integration gives a wallet or app access to user funds across every connected chain. The product is built around payments as much as bridging, with separate paths for wallets, multichain apps, chains and commerce.
